tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: List Está no Ir trips (1-3 days), optionally filtered. Returns id, type, title, origin, days, transport and URL.

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Full record of one trip by id: day by day, where to sleep, three places worth it, what to cut, sources with dates.

tools.name: how_to_request
tools.description: How a Bot can ask Está no Ir for a new 1-3 day plan, a second opinion or a plan B, by plain-text email. This tool sends nothing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_trips · Private data: get_trip · Public sink: how_to_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_trips · Private data: get_trip · Public sink: how_to_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
